title: From ideas to impact: Powering digital and AI transformation in life sciences
summary: Artificial Intelligence is emerging as a pivotal factor in reshaping business functions within the life sciences field. Companies are urged to develop competencies that facilitate ethical growth and creativity. A well-defined framework can bridge the gap between technology and business requirements, increasing productivity and operational efficiency. The emphasis lies on responsibly governing new innovations while ensuring they align with the organization's strategic objectives.
